about: An engineer: your tickets, what's waiting in review, and your bugs, across one or more projects.

views.label: My work
views.jql: project in ({{projects}}) AND assignee = currentUser() AND issuetype != "{{bug_type}}" AND (statusCategory != Done OR updated >= -14d) ORDER BY updated DESC

views.label: In review
views.jql: project in ({{projects}}) AND status in ({{review_statuses}}) AND (assignee = currentUser() OR reporter = currentUser() OR watcher = currentUser()) ORDER BY updated DESC

views.label: Bugs
views.jql: project in ({{projects}}) AND issuetype = "{{bug_type}}" AND assignee = currentUser() AND (statusCategory != Done OR updated >= -14d) ORDER BY priority DESC, updated DESC

views.label: Recent
views.jql: issue in issueHistory() ORDER BY lastViewed DESC
